prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE square transparent UI sprite atlas containing precisely nine hand-drawn furniture icons in a strict evenly spaced 3-column × 3-row grid.
Create finished production game icons for a Chinese mystery scene-reconstruction game with cream newspaper and investigation dossier UI. Every icon uses the SAME traditional ink-and-colored-pencil illustration style: crisp gently irregular dark sepia pen contour, small economical diagonal pencil hatching for depth, subtle desaturated watercolor/colored-pencil fills, warm walnut wood, muted olive, gray metal, occasional dusty teal. Convincing drawn object forms with visible 3/4 perspective, no flat geometric pictograms, no photorealism, no glossy 3D plastic.
Exactly square overall canvas. Think nine equal square cells, each icon centered inside its own cell. Uniform padding: each entire icon stays within the central 72% of its cell; leave broad EMPTY truly transparent gutters between rows and columns and transparent outer margin. Longest dimension of each object's silhouette occupies roughly the same 70–72% of its cell, irrespective of its real world size. All feet, handles, legs and wires complete inside cell, no clipping, no overlaps. Consistent clean line weight readable when scaled down to 70px.
The nine objects, EXACT ORDER read left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
Cell 1: a walnut office writing desk with two drawer pedestals, empty top.
Cell 2: a charcoal upholstered office swivel chair with five caster wheels.
Cell 3: a flat teal-screen monitor with stand and separate keyboard in front.
Cell 4: a tall brown wooden filing bookcase with four open shelves.
Cell 5: a short wooden two-level storage cabinet.
Cell 6: a cream floorstanding water cooler with translucent blue bottle and two taps.
Cell 7: a dark gray office printer with one white sheet in feed tray.
Cell 8: a small brass articulated desk lamp with rounded angled shade.
Cell 9: an olive-green leafy houseplant in a terracotta pot.
No text of any kind, no labels, no numbers, no frames, no colored squares or decorative panels behind objects, no paper texture outside the silhouette, no physical floor, no room, no big cast shadows, no contact shadow blobs. True transparent alpha around isolated objects. Each image shows JUST the entire corresponding object. Interior cream fills for paper objects are opaque, not punched out. Style consistency across every cell is essential.
